verdict.rationale: The evidence pack holds verbatim guidance-page text captured from https://www.impots.gouv.fr/ and /professionnel, including substantive sentences and site theme controls. That suggests the public reading surface returned server-rendered content to an automated fetch, not a CAPTCHA, bot-wall or JS-only shell. However, no evidence describes the fetch conditions, and coverage is limited to the homepage and the professional landing page. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent was used, evidence that deeper guidance and article pages (not only landing pages) are reachable without challenge, documentation of robots/bot policy or the absence of rate-limit walls, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
